years: c. 2021- (GX-215 manual rev. 01/2021; GX-215a manual rev. 10/2024)
notes: Stop names are the default Classic Allen voicing suite printed on the stop controls; the organ also has selectable stop lists (Classic Allen (default), English, Cavaille-Coll, Schlicker, Arp Schnitger and Aeolian-Skinner, plus optional Wurlitzer/Barton/Morton theatre suites) which re-voice and rename the stops.
The GX-215 manual prints the Celesta description at the end of the Pedal section; the GX-215a published stop list places Celesta in the Swell, which is used here.
Not included: optional GENISYS Voices stops, MIDI on <division>, Melody/Bass Coupler, Tremulants Full, Alternate Tuning, manual transfer/unenclosed and speaker/antiphonal controls.

Check on your organ: Allen channels follow the MIDI base channel (Swell = base channel, Great +1, Pedal +2, Choir +3; general pistons on channel 8). The base channel resets to 1 at power-on, so these channels normally apply.

Expression: in the default POLY-VOLUME mode each division's channel carries Control Change 7 (volume) from its expression shoe; Allen's minimum is about 20. If the organ is set to SWELL-VOLUME, POLY-VELOCITY or NO EXPRESSION the Great/Pedal (and Choir) volumes will not be recorded.

Stops are not bound: Allen sends and receives each stop as an NRPN (CC99 MSB, CC98 LSB, then CC6 127 = on / 0 = off, on the division's channel), which Cecilia's single-message bindings cannot express. A future NRPN driver is needed; 'Learn every stop' cannot tell Allen stops apart because every stop ends with the same CC6 message.
The organ's 'Transmit/Receive Stops' MIDI setting must be ON for stop changes to be sent or received at all.
